title: Independent assessment of a deep learning system for lymph node metastasis detection on the Augmented Reality Microscope.
summary: Independent evaluation of LYNA on 40 whole-slide images using the augmented-reality microscope reported an AUC near 0.98; this retrospective result is limited to the study setting. External replication and prospective utility were not established.
